title: Introducing the Infinibore
description:
After some time away we're back, and with something very special. A truly automatic mining machine that chops through water and lava like a V8 AU Falcon on the interstate. In this video we make our first demonstration of the power of TnT warping technology with a cannon to put tunnel bores to shame. A cannon that can blast out a hole to infinity from a standstill with minimal maintenance or supervision.

Intro track is Vinyl Sunset by The Dark Flame Master:
https://www.looperman.com/tracks/detail/199476

Dark made a much more compact and simpler variant of this system on his channel:
https://youtu.be/5hq4TwvVp6o

World download of the new and improved design, be sure the check out the video about the new system to learn more about its improvements, BE AWARE that the cannon WILL NOT work on different editions of the game such as paper/spigot, purpur or Bedrock edition::
https://www.mediafire.com/file/9fuqr80k22316ay/Ultimate_Infinibore.zip/file
